notes: blocks phosphorylation at S662, regulation of circadian clock

on_function: protein degradation; protein stabilization; intracellular localization; phosphorylation
notes: Phosphorylation of S662 promotes casein kinase I to phosphorylate nearby residues. CKI does not appear to phosphorlyate this residue (requires priming kinase).  Phosphorylation increased period length (tau).  Nonphosphorylated protein is mainly nuclear (as opposed to nuclear and cytoplasmic). Phosphorylated Per2 promotes its own transcription.
